three_judgments.path: FAILS. Mechanism: self-help cost-out lifting GM 13.2→16.5% (now hit) toward an undated, peso-dependent 18-20% 'next few years' target, off a DECLINING ~$570M revenue base. Tested vs §7 discriminators: margin inflection is REAL but FADING — SHOWS +330bps YoY in Q2 FY26 then only +50bps YoY (flat sequentially) in Q3, mgmt explicitly 'peak level as we lap prior actions'; backlog/RPO conversion ABSENT (revenue shrinking, EV programs -$9M cancelled); no firm-cash-contract catalyst; no GAAP-inflection bridge needed (already profitable). To 3x (~$970M) needs ~$65-75M NI at a fair 13-15x vs ~$14-15M clean now (~4-5x earnings) — heroic and stacked. Full 18-20% GM on a flat base ⇒ ~$40-50M NI ⇒ only ~1.5-2x at a steady multiple. ASSERTS a durable margin ramp; SHOWS a peaking one. Neither ≥4x nor protected 3-4x.
three_judgments.asymmetry: Weak. Bull ~1.5-2x (full margin target + some volume recovery + slight multiple lift), base ~flat-to-+20% (residual grind), bear ~-30-40% (cyclical/tariff downturn, continued volume loss, peso, multiple compression from a full ~21x clean P/E / ~11.5x flattered TTM). After +78%/yr the margin of safety is largely gone; U/D ratio ~1.5:1 at best — does not dominate, doesn't merit a scarce slot.
three_judgments.survival: PASS / no impairment. Net cash ~$106M, total debt ~$1M, FCF-positive (Q3 OCF $11.4M), profitable, $40M buyback — no going-concern, no debt wall, no dilution spiral. Survival is a clear pass; but survival alone does not earn a deep-dive slot when the path fails.

strongest_bear: STRT is a structurally low-growth ~$570M-revenue legacy vehicle-access supplier whose entire bull case was internal cost-out off a depressed base — and that program has substantially played out (GM at 16.5%, savings at their stated peak) while the top line shrinks (EV cancellations, Ford/Hyundai-Kia each -10%+, Q4 guided -3-4%). The stock has already re-rated +78% to a full ~21x clean consensus EPS, leaving a residual, undated, FX-contingent margin grind toward 18-20% worth perhaps ~1.5-2x — not a 3-4x. The reviewer fixed the size-class framing; the substance of the original drop survives.
